_comment: The census enumerates every field in ng2_settings.h itself. This file does
not list subjects - it explains the ones the census cannot verify on its
own, and every entry needs a reason a person can disagree with.
'reason' declares a setting that is deliberately not in the settings UI.
'doc_phrase' gives the words the public README uses for it, because the
README is written for players and says 'Detail strength', not
'texture_ai_strength'. Without it the census would demand identifiers in
prose, which would make the docs worse to pass a test.
'undocumented_ok' declares a setting that is reachable but is not worth a
line in the README - internal state a player sets by using the app, not by

declared.reason: cvar-only escape hatch (ng2_chapter12_workaround, on the F4 screen). The guard in patch_hooks.cpp makes it unnecessary; it exists only if that guard ever proves too permissive, and putting it in the player-facing menu would advertise a switch that should stay unused.
a run-once flag, not a knob. It records that first-run detection has happened so it does not run again; the player re-runs it with the Autodetect button instead.

retired from the UI in v1.0.21. On this title vsync off is not a tearing control but a SPEED control - the guest advances its logic on vblank, so off raises that from 60 Hz to ~1000 Hz and the game runs fast. The row is gone from both settings screens, Clamp() and the tuning force it on, and the field survives only so that older ng2_settings.cfg files still parse.

declared.doc_phrase: Live cost bars in this menu

declared.reason: Fine field-of-view multiplier for Ultrawide 3D. The in-menu slider was removed in v1.0.17 - the Ultrawide toggle alone picks the correct field of view for the monitor, and the slider added a per-value knob without a clear use - so this field is kept at its default (1.0) and only parsed from old settings files. The Ultrawide toggle itself is in the menu and documented.

retired from the UI 2026-09-27: rexgpu-xenos.dll is gone, so the game's own graphics system is the only renderer and 'off' would start none (a setting shown to break the game leaves every settings screen). The field survives only so that older ng2_settings.cfg files still parse; ng2_tuning.h forces ngpu_backend and gpu_offload_to_native on.
